desktop.note: NOT a like-for-like comparison: the sealed Phase 2 capture was made with Playwright Chromium 149, this one with Chrome for Testing 154, so font rasterisation and antialiasing differ everywhere and the changed fractions are an upper bound dominated by rendering differences. Real Phase 3 changes are the canonical default state shown on organ drawbars and synth faders, LEDs (effect focus, zone LEDs, amp velocity), the two OLEDs, the split LEDs on the rail and the status bar. Geometry is checked separately in stage3-capture.json (section fractions, 73 keys, 54/46 split).
